blocking_findings.criterion: brief.md criteria 6 and 7; design.md sections 6, 7, and 8
blocking_findings.title: Flood-wait mapping is missing on the GetInlineMenu and SendBotCommand production paths
evidence: design.md:158-162 requires each of the five new RPCs' TDLib call return sites to invoke FloodWaitFromError.

GetInlineMenu reaches Repo.GetChatHistory (service.go:185-188) or Repo.GetMessage (service.go:197). Repo.GetMessage at client_adapter.go:134-145 and Repo.GetChatHistory at client_adapter.go:261-272 return raw errors unchanged.

SendBotCommand reaches Repo.SendBotStartMessage (service.go:212-216) or Repo.SendMessage (service.go:219-224). Repo.SendMessage at client_adapter.go:89-100 returns raw errors, and Repo.SendBotStartMessage at client_adapter.go:390-401 also returns raw errors without FloodWaitFromError.

Only SearchPublicChat, GetUser, GetUserFullInfo, and GetCallbackQueryAnswer call FloodWaitFromError. A TDLib 429 on the other new RPC paths therefore maps to codes.Internal rather than ResourceExhausted + RetryInfo.
The green flood tests inject FloodWaitError directly into mapFacadeError and call the helper directly; they do not exercise these missing call sites.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Apply the infra flood conversion to every TDLib call site reachable from the five new RPCs while preserving the design's existing-path constraints, then add production-path tests (or strict integration-level repository tests) proving a retry-after error becomes ResourceExhausted + RetryInfo for all five RPCs.

blocking_findings.criterion: brief.md criteria 6 and 7; design.md section 7 callback deadline
blocking_findings.title: ClickCallbackButton's 10s server deadline is not enforceable
evidence: transport.go:295-297 creates a 10s context and passes it to facadeService.ClickCallbackButton.
facade.Service.ClickCallbackButton ignores the context parameter at internal/app/facade/service.go:201-207.
telegram.Repo.GetCallbackQueryAnswer at internal/infra/telegram/client_adapter.go:236-245 takes no context and calls go-tdlib directly.

go-tdlib client.Send in v0.7.6 waits with context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), client.catchTimeout), where catchTimeout defaults to 60s, so the gRPC deadline cannot cancel the in-flight TDLib call.
The test at transport_bot_test.go:148-165 only checks ctx.Done() != nil and returns context.DeadlineExceeded from the mock, so it passes even though production cannot honor the deadline.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Enforce the callback deadline at a layer that can observe it and return a DeadlineExceeded status at 10s. Bind the test to the elapsed deadline behavior (for example with a blocking fake and virtual time), not to a mock-supplied context error.

blocking_findings.criterion: brief.md criterion 6; design.md section 7 non-bot mapping
blocking_findings.title: GetBotInfo returns OK for a non-bot id instead of FailedPrecondition
evidence: design.md:151 requires a non-bot target -> FailedPrecondition.
go-tdlib v0.7.6 documents UserFullInfo.BotInfo as null if the user is not a bot (type.go:9571-9573), so TDLib does not necessarily return an error for this case.
transport.botInfoToProto returns an empty BotInfoResponse with OK when fullInfo or fullInfo.BotInfo is nil (transport.go:350-353).
There is no GetBotInfo validation test for UserFullInfo{BotInfo:nil}; facade TestService_GetBotInfo only covers a populated bot.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Detect the non-bot result (nil BotInfo) on the GetBotInfo path and return the semantic non-bot error so mapFacadeError yields codes.FailedPrecondition. Add a negative test.

follow_ups: O2 hardening: consider restricting the string fallback in FloodWaitFromError to wrapped TDLib errors if future evidence shows the permissive text match can mask another failure type. The locked design currently permits the text-based behavior.
O3 hardening: consider representing non-ResponseError callback failures explicitly if a production path starts producing them, rather than relying on the code-0/Internal fallthrough.

O5/O9 interface hardening: consider rejecting commands without a leading slash and rejecting /start-with-parameter when bot_user_id is zero as InvalidArgument. These are not required by the locked design.
O10 documentation: clarify that 'no reply waiting' excludes the synchronous callback answer, and correct the infra doc claim that SendBotStartMessage can currently return FloodWaitError.

Additivity check: mapFacadeError now maps context.DeadlineExceeded globally and Repo.GetCallbackQueryAnswer's error identity changed for the existing transform consumer; no current user-visible behavior change was proven, but the main session should track this as a regression risk.
